subject: Your friend at 3AM needs this app
preview_text: You know who I'm talking about. The one still stuck in a spiral. This is for them.
body_paragraphs: Remember that night you were wide awake at 3AM, replaying everything in your head, feeling like the world was ending? You found a way out. But there's someone in your life right now who hasn't. You know exactly who I'm talking about.

They're still stuck in the loop: checking their ex's social media, making excuses, crying in the bathroom at work. You've been where they are, and you know what helped—the AI therapist that never judges, the exercises that pulled you back from the edge. They don't have that yet.

Inside Fresh Start: Breakup Therapy, there's a share feature that lets you send a free therapy session to a friend. No strings attached. Just a lifeline at 3AM when they need it most. You've already healed—now it's your turn to pay it forward.

Open the app, tap the share button, and send them a session. One person. It could change everything.

P.S. They'll never know you sent it unless you tell them. But they'll feel the shift. And so will you.
